classifications.stable: Reserved for a separately approved post-Alpha compatibility promise.
classifications.preview: Declared Alpha export; callable but subject to documented pre-1.0 change.
classifications.compatibility: Retained delegating facade; use the recommended root or service facade.
classifications.internal: Not declared in __all__; no public compatibility promise.

claim_dispositions.canonical: Bounded task workflow listed by the capability authority.
claim_dispositions.advanced: Maintained specialist tool outside the small task API.
claim_dispositions.compatibility: Retained public surface without a canonical task claim.
claim_dispositions.hold: Callable preview surface that cannot support its broader advertised use until its named gate passes.

internal_policy: Every public-looking callable outside __all__ is tracked as internal.
